statement: A prospective-rubric calibration cannot rely on a scorer's programmatic rubricVersion option when its frozen execution path has no committed caller that supplies that option. The v22 recovery stopped before source access because the public CLI retained v17 and the v4 wrapper had no v22-selecting driver. Fix with a Git-tracked calibration launcher that invokes a built v22-only entrypoint under the same no-egress wrapper; test both that the launcher emits v22 and that the public CLI stays on v17. A future calibration must bind the launcher and built candidate before any cohort source is read.
quarantineReason: This staging record accompanies the repair branch, whose eventual squash commit does not yet exist on Cejel origin/main. It must not anchor to its own branch.
moveCondition: After this repair PR merges, identify its 40-character squash commit on Cejel origin/main and verify that its diff adds the Git-tracked v22 launcher, v22-only built entrypoint, public-v17 regression, and host-plus-runtime wrapper regression. Then copy this record into Alfred docs/orchestration/maeve-lesson-batches/ as a cejel_ batch with that commit, PR number, evidencePath, and evidenceQuote.
